preconditions.description: The input string E has length between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.
The counts of plus (P) and minus (M) operators are non-negative integers.
The smaller of the two operator counts is at most 100.
The sum of P and M equals the number of question marks in E.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789?()-' for c in E)
preconditions.description: The string E contains only digits, parentheses, question marks, and minus signs (though minus signs are replaced by '?', the structure implies valid nesting).

postconditions.expression: isinstance(stdout.strip(), str) and stdout.strip().isdigit() or (stdout.strip().startswith('-') and stdout.strip()[1:].isdigit())
postconditions.description: The output is a single integer (positive or negative) printed on one line.

postconditions.expression: max_value == max(eval_expr(E, ops) for ops in all_valid_operator_assignments(E, P, M))
postconditions.description: The output integer equals the maximum possible value of the expression E when exactly P plus signs and M minus signs are assigned to the '?' positions, respecting the structure of the expression.
